linewrought.return: Back in the seat. Thanks for keeping it warm.
linewrought.refit: New fit checked. Let's see what the workshop gave us.
linewrought.recovered_weapon: Recovered gun is firing. Better on our side.
linewrought.revisit: We've worked this ground before. Keep an eye on the approaches.

aurelian.return: Cleared for duty. Taking my station.
aurelian.refit: Revised weapon layout verified. Ready to test it.
aurelian.recovered_weapon: Recovered weapon operational. Custody has its advantages.
aurelian.revisit: Returning to familiar ground. Checking for changes.

kessa_vale.return: Doctor passed me. Now I inspect the work.
kessa_vale.refit: Different welds, different balance. The new fit passes inspection.
kessa_vale.recovered_weapon: Their workmanship. Our firing line. Inspection complete.
kessa_vale.revisit: I've inspected this ground before. Let's see what changed.

dorn_hess.return: Doctor says I can get shot at again. Generous of them.
dorn_hess.refit: New guns. Same seat. I remain cautiously attached to the seat.
dorn_hess.recovered_weapon: Better on this side of the argument.
dorn_hess.revisit: Here again. I was hoping for somewhere less familiar to my knees.

ilse_brant.return: Out of the infirmary. Never ask me to lie still again.
ilse_brant.refit: New fit, new balance. I'll find its corners.
ilse_brant.recovered_weapon: Their gun finally found a driver with somewhere to be.
ilse_brant.revisit: I know these turns. Taking a better line this time.

marek_sud.return: Good to hear the reactor again. The ward was too quiet.
marek_sud.refit: New mounts have a different hum. Listening for anything loose.
marek_sud.recovered_weapon: I remember that sound from the other side. Prefer it here.
marek_sud.revisit: Same ground. I'll listen for what wasn't here before.

petra_lindqvist.return: Back. Save the welcome for when everyone comes home.
petra_lindqvist.refit: A different arrangement. I'll let the shots give their opinion.
petra_lindqvist.recovered_weapon: It appears the enemy did have something useful to contribute.
petra_lindqvist.revisit: Familiar ground. That doesn't make it safe ground.

arne_gedde.return: Medical clearance confirmed. I intend to improve on the last result.
arne_gedde.refit: New layout calibrated. Precision survives a change of equipment.
arne_gedde.recovered_weapon: Recovered hardware. I will hold it to our standards.
arne_gedde.revisit: We have precedent here. This operation should be cleaner.

yusra_demir.return: Back with a few new data points on cockpit protection.
yusra_demir.refit: New configuration logged. Curious to see the field results.
yusra_demir.recovered_weapon: Recovered weapon firing. Now we can measure it properly.
yusra_demir.revisit: We have an earlier survey. Looking for discrepancies.

silas_okonkwo.return: Restored to duty. The paperwork was less survivable than the wound.
silas_okonkwo.refit: An amended specification. Let us hope the enemy appreciates revisions.
silas_okonkwo.recovered_weapon: A useful transfer of ownership. My compliments to recovery.
silas_okonkwo.revisit: Back on the same ground. A precedent, though hardly a guarantee.

anja_verrin.return: Fit for duty. One step at a time still works.
anja_verrin.refit: New fit checked slowly. Ready when the company is.
anja_verrin.recovered_weapon: Recovered gun answered cleanly. Keeping it steady.
anja_verrin.revisit: We've been here. Take time to look again.

bo_ferrant.return: Driver repaired. Try to keep this delivery upright.
bo_ferrant.refit: Different cargo on the brackets. Mind the turning circle.
bo_ferrant.revisit: Another delivery to this address. Hope somebody's signing.

bram_nyen.return: Back on shift. Thanks for carrying the load.
bram_nyen.refit: The load sits differently now. I'll keep it level.
bram_nyen.recovered_weapon: Recovery hauled it home. Putting it to work.
bram_nyen.revisit: Know the haul through here. Watching the shoulders.

cato_ferrin.return: Pilot repaired. Less conveniently than a pump, apparently.
cato_ferrin.refit: That's the new mount under load. Workshop did good work.
cato_ferrin.recovered_weapon: A little cleaning and it's earning its keep already.
cato_ferrin.revisit: Back here. Still looking at everything as spare parts.

corin_dast.return: Back. Had time to think about the wiring.
corin_dast.refit: The new circuit is steady. That'll do nicely.
corin_dast.recovered_weapon: Recovered trigger assembly is working. Small satisfaction.
corin_dast.revisit: Remember this ground. Taking another careful look.

dario_senn.return: Back in. I kept thinking about the people still out here.
dario_senn.refit: New weapons checked. I hope they make this shorter.
dario_senn.recovered_weapon: It was aimed at us. Hard to stop thinking about that.
dario_senn.revisit: Here again. I wonder who stayed.

juno_reyes.return: Enough bed rest. Point me at something worth the trip.
juno_reyes.refit: Oh, this fit has promise. Let's make some noise.
juno_reyes.recovered_weapon: You brought me a present. I'm sending a thank-you.
juno_reyes.revisit: Round two on familiar ground. Let's improve the finish.

leda_morcant.return: Back at work. My survival remains excellent value.
leda_morcant.refit: New configuration. I expect an excellent return.
leda_morcant.recovered_weapon: No purchase price. Very satisfying performance.
leda_morcant.revisit: We've done business here. Let's improve the terms.

mira_solvang.return: Medical release received. Returning to the task.
mira_solvang.refit: Revised loadout checked. No further adjustments needed.
mira_solvang.recovered_weapon: Recovered weapon tested under fire. Operational.
mira_solvang.revisit: Previous deployment noted. Reassessing current positions.

nadia_ostrow.return: Still standing. Let's get the rest of them home too.
nadia_ostrow.refit: Guns change. Keep your spacing and the rest follows.
nadia_ostrow.recovered_weapon: Good recovery work. Somebody made this drop easier.
nadia_ostrow.revisit: Old ground. New fight. Don't confuse the two.

oksana_valev.return: I'm back. That's all I want said about it.
oksana_valev.refit: New fit. Checked every fastening myself.
oksana_valev.recovered_weapon: It works. I'll decide if I trust it later.
oksana_valev.revisit: I remember this place. Keeping an exit in sight.

roz_havel.return: Cleared for duty. I'll be more careful with the cockpit this time.
roz_havel.refit: New layout memorised. I checked it twice.
roz_havel.recovered_weapon: That's one we brought home! It actually works!
roz_havel.revisit: I know this place now. I'll still check the map.

suri_kell.return: They finally let me out. I have some catching up to do.
suri_kell.refit: New fit? You shouldn't have. Let's try it properly.
suri_kell.revisit: Back for more. I know where I want to go this time.

tomas_arvel.return: Back by popular demand. Mine, mostly.
tomas_arvel.refit: New arrangement. Try to keep up with the demonstration.
tomas_arvel.recovered_weapon: Recovered gun. Consider this its better debut.
tomas_arvel.revisit: A return engagement. I do like a familiar stage.

willem_torrance.return: Back at the front. I've lost enough ground already.
willem_torrance.refit: New fit ready. Let me put some distance on it.
willem_torrance.recovered_weapon: Recovery gave us another edge. Using it.
willem_torrance.revisit: We crossed this ground before. Pressing further this time.
